_comment: THE ORDER OF OPERATIONS for map composition — canon, editable. Palle 2026-07-24: 'this is about order of operation, what is included in what order... then auto research to create the best combination or new strategies.' The research engines READ this file (stages, metric weights, bands): edit here, re-run, the search changes. Rounds history at the bottom. Sibling canons: cabinet_grammar.json, systems_fold.json.

operations.note: narrative (threshold, hero, kin ascending) edges crescendo in r1+r2

operations.what: measured union-AABBs from the probe floor
operations.note: never registry guesses; probe truth only

operations.what: TEMPLATE FIRST — the frame rooms grow into
operations.ruling: Palle r2: templates earlier — YES, decisive; typology dominated the ranking (courtyard swept top 9)
operations.track_note: track_13 (Palle 2026-07-24): x fixed 13, z as long as needed — concatenated authored 13x7 segments (commons/data/wizard_track_templates.json, role grammar shared with template_patterns.json). INVERTS op 3: rooms are authored, the artifact fits the room (FIT law at slot). The auto-plan grows FROM the order (segment chosen per artifact as it comes — order survives exactly, no misfits by construction). Kin-fill: spare slots take registry-category relatives of the cast. Arrival ops are template properties (gate_in = threshold+prologue, yard_seg = parapet). SEAM LAW: segment rows z0/z6 hold only walk or void, with the center columns x5-7 walkable — learned twice (yard wall row cut the track at reach 0.22; chamber's full-width room made z0 a dead pocket).
operations.harvest_note: 2026-07-25: the wizard's first 10 segments were invented while the project already held ~1,990 maps, template_patterns.json, 13 zone_grammar archetypes, staging_dna and 45 curated clusters. Harvest closes that gap: 112 candidate windows from 120 hand maps; 8 written; first composed track used h_structure_examples_1 alongside the authored segments (reach 0.91).

operations.what: grow the room AROUND the artifact (SDF/fractal thinking)
operations.note: SDF beats rect ~2x on fit (r1); grow clearance until area lands in the band

operations.what: thin wall segments + doors (layers.walls: nesw lower=wall, UPPER=door)
operations.note: one door per room toward the hall; wp on door pair when heights differ

operations.what: DOORS — a frame in every opening and the logic of its state (Palle 2026-07-25: 'door a frame and logic'; look = sliding_door from /props-dna-gallery, Portal/Half-Life pneumatic vocabulary)
operations.note: the artifact's own @identity IS the logic — 'Closed, it is wall. Open, it is corridor. Half-open, it is invitation.' So: the arrival threshold's mouth = corridor (1.0, you must pass), side-room doors = invitation (0.45), the quarantine's view notch = boundary (0.0). Token: lab_sliding_door:<rot>#panels_open_amount:<v>, rot from the cell toward what it opens onto. NAME COLLISION (the hangar mistake's twin): 'sliding_door' is registered by BOTH commons/artifacts/sliding_door (the lab door) and commons/primitives/translation (a teaching demo that renders an orange 'Slide ->' panel) — the primitive wins resolution, so an alias lab_sliding_door was added to registry/lab.json as the unambiguous handle. Verified by capture: dark frame, two near-white panels, centre seam, accent stripe. SIGNS: exit_sign is the door's declared partner (cluster_with) and its truth is 'the sign is the PROMISE that there IS a way out' — so every opening is NAMED by the artifact behind it (exit_sign:<rot>:2.0#text:<NAME>#sign_color:<c>), mounted on the wall BESIDE the frame at head height, never floating: green for egress, red for QUARANTINE, accent-blue for a named room. 8 doors / 8 signs on the test gate.

operations.what: the quarantine yard and other set pieces
operations.note: r3: yard INTEGRATED as a composition slot, not an island across a runway
procession scored only after r2 gave elevation a metric

operations.what: SPANS — a gap you cross instead of floor you fill: bridge over a causeway, or (Minecraft's mineshaft logic) a CARVED chasm with the deck left spanning it
operations.note: deck rises one step, aligned wedges at BOTH ends (LIFT law — a one-wedge bridge scored reach 0.51), hb railings on the void flanks (first use of hb in 1,987 maps). Preconditions beat reverts: check the climbs are placeable and the chain is WALL-FREE before mutating — the first carve landed against a chamber's north wall segment and severed the track (the SEAM law's cousin: consult layers.walls, not just floor).

operations.what: connective tissue LAST — and cared for
operations.note: r3: width-2 passages with width-3 pulse; longest-naked-run penalised (tissue metric)

operations.what: the entry as STORY — compression threshold, prologue artifact in the corridor, release into the court, overview parapet at the yard (v3's hand-composed arc, made composable)
operations.note: r5: story metric = mean(pinch, release, prologue, overlook); the threshold costs compact — the search arbitrates. r6: parapet GUARANTEED by side-search s→w→n (east = teleporter's), all-or-nothing landing, approach from existing floor only — 54/54 requested, 0 misses.

operations.what: THE PRINCIPAL HANGAR WALL — one wall with props and related artifacts, LAST in the order (Palle 2026-07-24: 'add wall hangar principal... find good spot to add wall and not brake the path')
operations.note: candidate = a straight 3-cell run (floor or void) with walkable standoff on one side; score = 0.4 late-in-walk + 0.4 open-front (the gaze law) + 0.2 dead-back (seals nothing); REACHABILITY IS A VETO not a term — a candidate that would strand the teleporter landing or any artifact is dropped, so the wall can never break the path. Dressing = cluster token rotated to face the standoff; flanks take small kin of the cast. GOTCHA the veto taught: the teleporter stands on VOID by law, so it is never in the walkable set — the target is its LANDING (first version rejected all 427 candidates by asking the impossible). CORRECTION (Palle: 'but did you find the hangar wall system?') — v1 used the Wall Hangar EDITOR's curated cluster files (station_* pieces). THE HANGAR WALL SYSTEM is commons/artifacts/hangar_* with the kit _hangar/hangar_kit.gd: hangar_wall_panel (the backing wall that stands ON the floor, plane facing +Z — so no h4 cubes: the panel IS the wall) plus hangar_podium / worktable / supply_pile / barrier_fence / cabinet_cluster / step_base as the props, all map_ready and — until now — placed in ZERO maps. style='hangar' (default) composes panel run + props in front + kin one row further into the standoff; style='cluster' keeps the old curated-cluster behaviour.

operations.what: LANDMARK + LIGHTS — Minecraft's village square: one stepped tower on void beside the walk (visible from everywhere, costs no walkable cell) and `el` overhead lights every N cells of walk distance
operations.note: el was used 193 times in hand maps and NEVER by the wizard; the landmark scores on floor-cells-within-2 (visibility) x mid-walk position (homing). Cheapest legibility per cell in VR.

interfaces.wizard: /map-wizard (encyclopedia) — the order of operations as a walkable wizard; every step shows its own abstraction (order=1D strip, typology=three frames, elevation=SECTION, paths=plan); engine tools/wizard_compose.py reads THIS file
interfaces.recipes: commons/data/wizard_recipes/*.json — saved runs (spec+score+pathfinder); the wizard as memory; seeded from research rounds 2+3 winners
interfaces.dressing: stage 4b: hangar wall system enters composition as cluster:<name>:<rot> on the room's back wall, facing the artifact (45 curated clusters)
interfaces.track: track_13 mode: spec.track {enabled, plan:auto|[segments], kin_fill}; engine compose_track in tools/wizard_compose.py; segments editable in wizard_track_templates.json — author a segment, it becomes vocabulary
interfaces.laws_prose: doc/COMPOSITION_LAWS.md — the laws WITH their stories + meta-laws + the large-artifact frontier (type-routed placement proposal); this canon holds the what, the doc holds the why
interfaces.arc_lens: doc/ARC_ORGANIZATION.md — organization = inducibility (ARC-AGI lens): the canon ops as a DSL, sequences as few-shot tasks, priors↔laws table, the compression caution (band not maximand), round-11 candidates (inverse composer grammar_fit first)
interfaces.grammar_fit: tools/grammar_fit.py — the INVERSE composer (ARC lens): map -> induced rule sentence (frame/order/elevation/symmetry/rooms/arrival clauses), organization as a BAND not a maximand, residual = the protected irreducible; index commons/data/grammar_fit_index.json (1,987 maps)
interfaces.hangar_wall_system: commons/artifacts/hangar_* (7 props) + commons/artifacts/_hangar/hangar_kit.gd; registry/packaging.json; resolver _hangar/packaging_resolver.gd is GATED off by default (auto_spawn), which is why the family was invisible — op 9 places them EXPLICITLY as map tokens instead
interfaces.harvest: tools/harvest_segments.py — the corpus AS the template library: cuts 13-wide windows from the best-organized hand maps (grammar_fit index, ALIVE band, non-generated), translates them into the track role grammar, SPINE-ALIGNS them to x=6 so they concatenate, and gives each TYPED SOCKETS (north/south open columns + shared spine — Minecraft's jigsaw idea). Output commons/data/wizard_track_harvested.json, auto-loaded by compose_track (spec.track.harvest=false to opt out).

laws: FIT: a piece whose envelope exceeds the room belongs to another room (exclude, record why)
REACH: high-aspect envelopes are reach, not body — space by body, aim reach along the walk (ENFORCED since wizard_compose: aspect>4 rooms sized by body; rounds 1-3 paid the cost instead)
MOAT-AS-HYPOTHESIS: runtime growth is stochastic; containment is re-tested every run
spawn token is exactly 's'; teleporter stands on void; climbing requires wp; a door must open onto floor
static measurement is not runtime envelope (growth-class artifacts need settle-time probing)
SEAM (track): segment seam rows carry walk at the shared center columns; a wall or a room on the seam cuts the world (reach tells, the OK label does not)

LIFT (track/elevation): no lift without a step — every procession-raised room needs a wp climb at its mouth; a doorless lifted room strands its artifact (r7: spine niches at h2, unreach 2 across every +4 plan — the first leaderboard was a lie the LIFT law exposed)

ROLE: past a threshold an artifact stops being furniture and becomes architecture — floor IS the ground (terrain_field), monument IS the room (hall_grand pass-through), wall IS the wall (tableau_face); route by staging posture, and derive the posture from the MEASURED floor, not a stale oracle
WALL-VETO (op 9): a composed wall is legal only if the walk survives it — verify reachability of every artifact and the exit landing BEFORE writing, and target the landing not the teleporter cell

WEDGE-YAW: `wp` takes its yaw as parameter 0 and belongs on the LOW cell of a step, rising toward the high one — N:180 E:90 S:0 W:270 (validated by yaw-sweep probe Probe_WedgeYaw + the deck maps). A bare `wp` is always yaw 0, so three of four steps misalign — the wizard wrote bare wp until 2026-07-25

rounds.finding: METRIC BLIND — room_fit optimized closets; score could not see enclosure/arrival/hall. Falsified its own scorer.
templates-early decisive (courtyard swept top 9); score+eye agree; weakness = naked connective tissue; hall_wings starved by one-sided implementation.

YARD-AS-SLOT works — tissue 1.0 everywhere, the runway to quarantine is gone by construction; fair two-sided hall_wings competitive; procession sweeps. NEW LEAK FOUND: the hall's spawn approach became the runway (compact only 0.17-0.24) — the plane hid inside the typology. Round-4 target: hall trimmed to room extent / chain wrapped into L or square; best-of-breed recipe = courtyard ring (r2) + yard-as-ring-slot (r3) + banded SDF rooms + trimmed approach.

RUN THROUGH THE WIZARD ENGINE (tools/wizard_compose) — research and wizard now share one composer; the winner recipe lands in wizard_recipes automatically. THE RIBBON IS DEAD: compact min 0.45 / median 0.52 / max 0.66 over 90 passing (was 0.17-0.24 in r3), 66/90 at/over target, 90/90 pass pathfinder. Credit goes to the REACH LAW, not the trim lever: every trim pair scored IDENTICAL (trim never fired — body-sized rooms leave no approach slack). The round-3 ribbon was reach-cost in disguise: laser_measure's 51-cell envelope inflated every layout; body-sizing removed it everywhere at once. sdf_blob wins its first round (organic petals on the courtyard ring at body scale); courtyard/procession sweeps top 3. Tightest winner of any round.
rounds.promoted: Thread_Gate v4 (standing gate) — Palle's ruling 2026-07-24, eye+score both met; v3's narrative arc (compression corridor, measuring hall) remains the open edge for round 5

rounds.finding: ARRIVAL AS STORY — v3's hand-composed arc (compression threshold, prologue artifact in the corridor, release, overview parapet) became op 8 + a story metric (canon v5, weight 0.12). STORY PAYS +0.180: best bare 0.613 vs best full-story 0.793 on identical geometry; full-story configs sweep the entire top 16. The threshold's compact cost was absorbed (28x25 unchanged from r4 — the corridor fit the bbox slack). Engine lesson: the corridor must be carved AFTER rooms (west of all floor in its rows) and mouth into a DOOR when it meets a room — carving before rooms sealed the courtyard spawn (1/249 reachable, caught by reach not by FAIL). Caveat recorded: parapet silently no-ops when the yard's ring slot leaves no walkway cells (crescendo/narrative courtyards) — placement is position-dependent, not guaranteed.
rounds.promoted: Thread_Gate v5 (standing gate) — Palle's ruling 2026-07-24; the machine composition now carries the narrative arc that was v3's last exclusive claim

rounds.finding: GUARANTEED PARAPET (engine-fix round, rubric unchanged) — the parapet now side-searches s→w→n with all-or-nothing placement, never stomps rooms, approach from existing connected floor only. 54 parapet-requested variants, 0 overlook misses. THE FIX CHANGED THE RANKING: r5's casualties became the winners — crescendo/narrative full-story courtyards (0.754 without their parapet in r5) found a WEST-side parapet and hit 0.800, edging the standing gate's rhythm packing (0.793). Story pays +0.187. Lesson: a guarantee is not a repair, it is a re-ranking — variants that lost to a position accident were better all along.
rounds.promoted: Thread_Gate v6 (standing gate) — Palle's ruling 2026-07-24; the guarantee's re-ranking honored: the crescendo spiral holds the gate

rounds.finding: TRACK PLANS AS SEARCH SPACE — five plan policies (auto/dense/breath/monument/pairs) x kin extension (+0/+2/+4) x three orders. FIRST RUN WAS POISONED: procession lifted the doorless spine niches with no wp climb -> unreach 2 on every +4 plan; the leaderboard read '+4 kills, auto worst' and both were the bug. LIFT law added (no lift without a step), re-run: 45/45 pass, and the findings INVERTED — kin +4 pays (mean 0.646 vs 0.638) and DENSE (walled-only grammar) sweeps the top 9 (mean 0.666 > auto 0.644 > monument 0.642 > breath 0.625 ~ pairs 0.624). Enclosure and walls, not open breath, are what the rubric rewards in a band. Track ceiling ~0.67 vs the courtyard gate's 0.800: the hall/enclosure shares are structural to the format — the track is a curriculum band format, not a gate rival. Never trust a leaderboard whose failures share one number.

rounds.winner: no score winner declared — the rubric is role-blind; the eye rules
rounds.finding: TYPE-ROUTED PLACEMENT — postures (classify_postures) route artifacts to ROLE segments; two new segments (terrain_field: walk THROUGH the artifact-as-ground; tableau_face: artifact against a wall band with standoff — first draft violated the SEAM law with a full wall band and cut the track, caught by reach again). THREE findings: (1) THE POSTURE SOURCE WAS STALE — classify reads artifact_sizes.json while the composer reads the probe floor; measured-size postures re-type 8/23 symmetry artifacts (looms/mills pedestal->platform; atlas gallery pedestal->FLOOR — the role change firing for real). Cross-tool: dressing rooms inherit the same staleness. (2) The rubric cannot see role-fit: type-routed tracks tie (0.649) or lose slightly (change 0.668 vs 0.686; typeM 0.619) while being SHORTER and architecturally differentiated — scoring open-role architecture needs a grounded metric, not a circular one. (3) AURA added at weight 0 (standoff vs 0.8x max-dim, gaze law): it SATURATES at 1.0 in track mode (open bands always grant standoff) — it will only discriminate in gate-mode rooms; weighting it now would be noise. Verdict deferred to the eye (captures of size vs typeM); promotion of measured postures into classify_postures = the actionable next.
rounds.actioned: 2026-07-24 same day, Palle's ruling: classify_postures now reads the MEASURED floor — load_sizes() overlays artifact_elements.json union AABBs over the stale oracle (1569/2660 probe-sourced), and a table/pedestal HINT on a body taller than a person or broader than furniture is overruled by measurement (the tool's own name-beats-hint precedent, measured edition; posture_overrides still supreme). 447/2660 postures corrected (flows: pedestal->platform 95, pedestal->monument 59, pedestal->floor 53...). Diff: commons/data/posture_probe_diff.json. Dressing rooms NOT regenerated (--write stays explicit).

rounds.winner: crescendo/sdf_blob/courtyard 0.82 — the standing gate's own combo; no new map kept
rounds.finding: AURA IN GATE MODE — the gaze law (standoff >= 0.8 x max dimension) measured with honest sight: the scan now stops at wall segments and passes through doors (it previously saw through walls). Spread real but modest: 0.84-1.00, sd 0.07 — most gate rooms already grant standoff, chiefly through their doorways into the hall; the dips are narrative-order variants whose large pieces sit blind. ADOPTED at weight 0.07 (canon v6, weights rebalanced sum 1.0): the ranking's top is stable under it (standing combo rank 1 in both phases, 0.80 -> 0.82) while mid-table shifts +/-7-9 ranks — discrimination without upheaval. Aura still saturates in track mode (open bands grant standoff by construction) — there it is a format truth, not a free ride. The rubric is now ready for gate-mode real casts where big bodies will actually starve for viewing distance.

THE REAL CAST MEETS GATE MODE (rubric v6, symmetry 23) — and the runner's own summary lied the way round 7 taught us to catch: it printed 27/27 passing from the pathfinder's OK label while all NINE courtyard variants hard-failed on unreachable artifacts (score 0). TRUE pass 18/27. (1) COURTYARD HAS A SCALE CEILING: at 24 ring slots the rooms overlap and bury each other — compact 0.8, pretty and broken; the ring is a small-cast form. (2) THE FORMATS CONVERGE: at 23 artifacts the surviving gate typologies stretch to 130-135 wide — the gate at real scale IS a band with grown rooms; gate and track meet in the middle. (3) AURA IS A GUARD-RAIL, NOT A JUDGE: 0.82-1.00 even for the giants (doorway sightlines + big grown rooms satisfy the gaze law by construction); it disciplines blind side-wall placements and nothing else. (4) PEDAGOGY IS AFFORDABLE: the sequence's own order scores within 2% of rhythm (0.481 vs 0.491 mean) — curriculum maps can keep their teaching order. Cross-format under v6: best gate ~0.745 vs track ~0.68 — the rubric prefers grown enclosure; the track's virtues (fixed width, VR band) remain partly unpriced.

rounds.winner: no winner — a measurement round: every map got its rule sentence
rounds.finding: THE INVERSE COMPOSER (ARC lens: organization = inducibility) — grammar_fit reads any map and induces its rule in the canon's vocabulary. VALIDATION: it re-induced Trial_gate10_21's generating spec exactly (frame:spine + order:rhythm(1.0) + elevation:procession(0.87) + rooms:banded(0.95)) — the forward program recovered by inverse fit. Corpus sweep: 1,987 maps, mean organization 0.48; bands 1,596 alive / 383 noise-risk (the triage list) / 8 monotone-risk (ceremonial courts at 1.00 — ring+mirror+compression, correctly flagged as pattern-saturated). Thread_Gate reads frame:ring + rooms:banded + arrival:compression. KNOWN LIMITS recorded: BFS encounter order is bidirectional on rings (a real walker picks one direction — crescendo-on-ring under-detected); ring redefined as court-with-petals via artifact angular spread (not annulus). Organization stays a BAND per the compression thesis: the residual of hand maps is protected, not demolished.

vertical_vocabulary.teleport: t on void — the exit, and long jumps
vertical_vocabulary.door: d — a transition that reads as a threshold (UNUSED; the wizard uses UPPERCASE wall segments instead)
vertical_vocabulary.railing: hb horizontal_border — the bridge/parapet edge piece (UNUSED)
